title: K8sConfig
description: Configuration for the Kubernetes cloud-burst Provisioner backend (ARC-13 / ADR-20, #434): where in a Kubernetes cluster to burst ephemeral worker pods, what image they run, and how each joins the cluster. Mirrors the Azure reference (azure_config.schema.json) / GCP / OCI via the CLI pattern. Mirrored by zetta::K8sConfig in include/zetta/k8s_provisioner.hpp and enforced by K8sConfig::from_json() in src/core/k8s_provisioner.cpp — keep them in sync. No Kubernetes client library lives behind the provisioner; this config is interpreted by a K8sControlPlane (the reference K8sCliControlPlane shells out to the `kubectl` CLI, the Deployment + scale shape). Unlike the cloud backends, the cluster already exists — it is the kubeconfig context, configured out-of-band. A malformed config is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured burst fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or no) fleet.

image.description: The container image the burst worker pods run (e.g. 'ghcr.io/oramasearch/zetta:latest'). Required — a burst has nothing to run without it.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace the burst Deployment + pods live in. Defaults to 'default' when omitted.

deployment_name.description: Name of the burst Deployment (the pool). Stable so create + scale are idempotent. Defaults to 'zetta-burst' when omitted.

context.description: The kubeconfig context (cluster + user) to target. Empty uses the current context. The cluster itself is provisioned out-of-band (e.g. eks/gke/oke get-credentials).

service_account.description: The Kubernetes ServiceAccount the burst pods run as (their in-cluster identity, distinct from the zetta-side Principal/AccessKey the BurstIdentityManager mints). Empty uses the namespace default.

spot.description: Schedule the burst pods onto spot/preemptible nodes (a nodeSelector). Defaults to false (any node).

seed_peer.description: The cluster seed address (host:port) injected as the ZETTA_SEED_PEER env var so each pod auto-joins the existing peer cluster at boot. Empty when the join address is supplied another way.
